title: Native derived pullback comparison preserves finite evaluation
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, any morphism f:X→Y of schemes, any unbounded derived coefficient system M on Y and n≥0, evaluate integralNativePullIso [lem-sf-integral-native-direct-comparison], then compose native evalG [def-sp-varying-ring-operations] with the exact derived coordinate change of openSquarePullbackModel [def-trf-finite-pullback-coordinate-comparison]. This composite equals the specified pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison]. This holds on entire systems for arbitrary inputs, with no boundedness, cartesianness, constructibility or properness hypothesis.

source.place: Coefficient comparisons preserve evaluation and adjunction units/counits; primitive whole-system operation comparison in Step 1 of lem-sf-integral-support-strict-tower-comparison. Stacks 03DI, 0941, 0D6E; Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10.

proof.text: Apply integralNativeOrdinaryPullEvaluation to the same morphism and every ordinary input. Localize its composite square using the exact-functor composition isomorphisms and the proved compatibility of mapDerivedCategoryNatIso with whiskering. The private generic localizePullSquare proof cancels the composition comparisons and localizes the ordinary natural-isomorphism equality.

Use the already proved derivedEvaluation_eq helper from IntegralDirectEvaluationMateInvertible. Its whole cochain normalization identifies the localized ordinary inverse-evaluation square with pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation. Unfold only the named integralNativePullIso and evalG wrappers to identify the left side. These operations are exact localizations and the argument applies to all unbounded derived inputs.

proof_origin.place: U3: normalized ordinary mates and exact localization, the inverse-image step in the native open comparison. This helper is fully proved, isolated to keep each module below the 60-second compile limit.

lean.statement:
theorem integralNativePullEvaluation {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (M : System l E Y) :
    let := sfIntrinsicPullback_additive (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    let := sfIntrinsicPullback_preservesFiniteLimits (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    let := sfIntrinsicPullback_preservesFiniteColimits (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).map
        ((integralNativePullIso l E f).hom.app M) ≫
      (ProEtale.VaryingRing.evalG (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
        (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f n).hom.app M ≫
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
        (openSquarePullbackModel (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) f)).hom.app
          ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n).obj M) =
      (pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation l E f n).hom.app M
